The root face cost is exactly Jrem+e I(g)/2 and Q_bad<=Jrem+pi I(g)=I(F)-d_X. One marked reserve, consumed before descent and never renewed, proves H(F)<=(5+2/ln2)(d_X+Jrem)+pi H(g)+e I(g)/2.
